review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore KG is the customer app of a single electronics retail company operating in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. The app shows the company catalog and lets a customer place an order for pickup or delivery, follow its status, register warranty devices, request a return, use bonus points and contact store support. All content belongs to the company; there is no user-generated content and no third-party marketplace.

HOW TO SIGN IN
Sign-in is by phone number plus a one-time code delivered over SMS; there is no sign-up form and no stored login form field. Kyrgyz mobile operators do not deliver SMS to numbers outside the country, so the review account is bound to the owner phone number that receives the code inside Kyrgyzstan. Please request the code from us through App Review Notes / Contact and we will relay the current one-time code within minutes during the review window: enter the phone number given in the Demo Account fields, tap Continue, ask us for the code, then enter it. Codes are short-lived, so please request one immediately before you need it. We do not place any live code in these notes.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Checkout finishes against the production payment provider; for review we can move the review account to a zero-amount order flow on request, so no real charge is made. Face ID is optional and only unlocks an already signed-in session. Push notifications carry order, warranty and support updates only; the app does not track users and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.
